subject: Request: SOC 2 VM artifacts and patch trace for audit
messages:
From: FinTrust Security <security@fintrust.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: auditor@compliancenow.io
Date: 2027-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 VM artifacts and patch trace for audit

Hi Karthik,

We are kicking off the SOC 2 readiness review for FinTrust and need a compact artifact bundle from Redwood covering your vulnerability management program. Specifically we'd like: 
- a short index of artifacts (scan cadence, responsible owners)
- machine-readable patch trace showing CVE -> patch commit -> deploy (signed or checksumed if possible)
- raw scan logs for the last two scans (dependency and host scans)
- your SLA definitions for CVE remediation windows by severity

Can you confirm you can provide these artifacts by COB Aug 18? If you have an on‑line binder or Drive folder please share. Our auditor will need an integrity check on any trace files.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
FinTrust Security
security@fintrust.com

Attachment: fintrust_request_checklist.pdf (stub)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: FinTrust Security <security@fintrust.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, auditor@compliancenow.io
Date: 2027-08-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 VM artifacts and patch trace for audit

Marta — thanks for the checklist and the heads up. We can provide the requested materials and will bundle them into a single audit binder. High-level notes up front: 
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated host scans + weekly dependency scans for service repos; monthly external network scans.
- CVE remediation SLAs (our operational SLO table): Critical: 72 hours to mitigation plan, 14 days to deployed fix unless compensating control; High: 7 days to mitigation plan, 30 days to fix; Medium/Low: standard 90/180 day windows.
- Patch trace: we will provide a signed .zip containing the mapping (CVE -> internal ticket -> PR/commit -> deploy timestamp) and a SHA256 checksum file.
- Raw logs: will include the last two runs for both host and dependency scanners (time-window: 2027-06-01 to 2027-08-12).

I have looped in Laura from Legal for an attestation cover note and our Security ops owner for trace verification. We will put the binder in a Drive folder and share a link with you; the signed checksum file will be included for the auditor to validate. Planned delivery: final bundle sent Aug 18 EOD PT.

If you need anything earlier (on‑hand evidence for an urgent control review) let me know and we can prioritize.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: planned-binder-index.csv (stub)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-15T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: verify patch-trace contents and checksum before external delivery

Monica / Ben — forwarding FinTrust's request (below). I drafted the response and plan to upload the final binder on Aug 18. Before I send the final link to the customer/auditor I need you to: 
1) Confirm the patch-trace zip includes an immutable manifest with SHA256 checksums for each artifact and that the manifest itself is signed by Security Ops (GPG or our internal signing key).
2) Verify the trace covers the full lifecycle for each CVE referenced (ticket id, PR/commit hash, image digest, deploy timestamp, env).
3) Confirm the scan logs attached include dependency-scan outputs (SCA) and the host authenticated scan results; highlight any suppressed/accepted risks and include short justification notes.
4) Produce a one‑page verification note (signed) we can include as the attestation cover.

I can include your verification note in the binder and will CC it to FinTrust. Please reply with confirmation or issues by EOD Aug 17 so I have time to assemble.

On Tue, Aug 14, 2027 at 9:12 AM FinTrust Security <security@fintrust.com> wrote:
> Hi Karthik,
> 
> We are kicking off the SOC 2 readiness review for FinTrust and need a compact artifact bundle from Redwood covering your vulnerability management program. Specifically we'd like: 
> - a short index of artifacts (scan cadence, responsible owners)
> - machine-readable patch trace showing CVE -> patch commit -> deploy (signed or checksumed if possible)
> - raw scan logs for the last two scans (dependency and host scans)
> - your SLA definitions for CVE remediation windows by severity
> 
> Can you confirm you can provide these artifacts by COB Aug 18? If you have an on‑line binder or Drive folder please share. Our auditor will need an integrity check on any trace files.
> 
> Thanks,
> Marta Ruiz
> FinTrust Security
> security@fintrust.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-17T10:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: verify patch-trace contents and checksum before external delivery

Karthik — confirmed. Quick summary of validation steps we completed: 
- patch-trace-verified.zip contains: patch-manifest.csv (mapping CVE -> TICKET-IDs -> PRs -> image digests -> deploy timestamps), a signed manifest.sig (GPG key id: 0xA1B2C3D4), and a README.md describing process. SHA256 checksums for each artifact are in checksums.sha256 (we computed them on the final artifacts build).
- Coverage: we verified the manifest covers the 18 CVEs FinTrust flagged as Critical/High in their preflight. For each CVE the PR and commit hash are present and the deploy timestamp corresponds to the production rollout (k8s rollout timestamp + image digest).
- Scan logs: included scan-logs-202706-202708.tar.gz contains dependency-scan.json and host-scan.xml. The dependency scan includes the SCA provider output (component list + CVE mapping) and host scan includes authenticated evidence and any accepted risk rationales.
- We generated a one‑page signed verification (VM_Verification_20270817.pdf) that describes scope, methods, and a checksum summary.

No blockers found. I will push the final artifacts to the audit Drive and share the link so you can attach to the external reply. If you want, I can include a short appendix listing compensating controls for any CVEs still in remediation.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: VM_Verification_20270817.pdf (stub)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: FinTrust Security <security@fintrust.com>
Cc: auditor@compliancenow.io, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-18T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Final: audit binder and verified patch trace (SOC 2 artifact bundle)

Marta — thanks for your patience. The audit binder is ready and available at the Drive link below. Included in the top-level folder: 
- vm_audit_index.csv (index of artifacts, owners, scan cadence table)
- patch-trace-verified.zip (contains patch-manifest.csv, checksums.sha256, manifest.sig (GPG))
- scan-logs-202706-202708.tar.gz (dependency + host scans)
- VM_Verification_20270817.pdf (signed one-page verification note)
- attestation_cover_note.pdf (legal attestation from Redwood)

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cRedwood_VM_Audit_2027
SHA256 for patch-trace-verified.zip: 9f2b3c6e4a1b... (full checksum in checksums.sha256 inside the zip)

Short operational clarifiers: 
- Scan cadence: weekly for SCA/host scans; weekly cadence reflected in the index file.
- CVE SLAs: Critical — 72h to mitigation plan, High — 7 days to plan; remediation windows noted in vm_audit_index.csv.
- Trace integrity: the manifest.sig is a GPG signature from our security operations key; checksums are included for all artifacts for the auditor to verify.

If you want a hashed manifest sent separately or a live verification session with your auditor for checksum validation, we can schedule a short call. Happy to walk through the binder next week.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vm_audit_index.csv; patch-trace-verified.zip; scan-logs-202706-202708.tar.gz
